preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 20.
The number of nodes N in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries Q in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= A[i] <= 100 for all i in range(1, N+1)
preconditions.description: Each node value A[i] must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u, v, a, b <= N and a != b
preconditions.description: All node indices u, v, a, b must be valid and a must not equal b.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum difference of values on the path between nodes a and b.
